templates.name: 11. 粒子消散
templates.description: 动效转场：粒子消散 / Particle Dissolve — the outgoing scene breaks apart into thousands of tiny glowing particles that drift and dissolve, the particles regrouping to form the incoming scene
templates.description_en: Particle Dissolve - the outgoing scene breaks apart into thousands of tiny glowing particles that drift and dissolve, the particles regrouping to form the incoming scene
templates.prompt:
A seamless Particle Dissolve transition effect between two scenes.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-3s] The first scene holds steady in a cinematic composition. The frame is stable, the lighting is balanced, and the subject is clearly visible, establishing the visual context that will be transformed by the transition.
[Shot 2] [3-6s] The outgoing scene breaks apart into thousands of tiny glowing particles that drift and dissolve, the particles regrouping to form the incoming scene. The transition executes with fluid, natural motion and cinematic quality. The camera movement and visual effect remain smooth and continuous, completing the handoff from the first scene to the second scene seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: a soft crackling swarm of particles, gentle spatial drift. No dialogue, no music in the soundscape layer.

non_diegetic_music: a delicate electronic music box melody, synced to the rhythm of the transition for a polished editorial feel.
